name: DHL Supply Chain - Keurig DC - Union City GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (2025-10) clearly shows a chain-link perimeter fence separating the office/car-parking area from the truck yard, with a gate where the truck access drive crosses the fence line. A 'DEAD END / NO TRACTOR TRAILERS BEYOND THIS POINT' sign marks the car/office side, confirming a controlled separation of truck and visitor traffic.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No large multi-window staffed guard booth visible at the gate in any Street View capture (2019, 2025). The gate structure is small. Classified guardShack false / remoteGs true (kiosk or automated check-in implied) - flagged as a medium-confidence call given the small/obscured structure.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no clear guard booth - implies remote/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building: continuous dock-door banks run the full ~440 m length of both the N and S faces, with dense rows of trailers backed in on both sides. Total door count well into the 100+ range; estimated ~120, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Marked trailer-parking rows along the S yard hold many trailers without tractors; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on two distinct building faces (N and S) - typical cross-dock shipping/receiving split.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows in the S yard, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry apron and large open dock yards give ample paved width to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Access drive from Studio Way runs a long distance into the property before reaching the dock yards - room for 3+ trucks to queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Union City is within the Atlanta metro (Fulton County), adjacent to I-85 and dense industrial development. Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; I-85 runs to the SE.
